Added under decision 0114, which is why this row carries no models: the vendor serves its own list and the device reads it with the person's own key. Read on 2026-09-03: https://llm.chutes.ai/v1/models answers anonymously with an OpenAI-shaped envelope whose rows carry context_length, max_output_length, supported_features, input_modalities and a pricing object, and https://llm.chutes.ai/v1/chat/completions answers a credential-less POST with 429 rather than 404, so the family's own path is the address. No key_prefix is recorded: no page read on that date states one, and a prefix nobody published would be a form refusing a valid key.

The provider class stays derived from the credential in use. The vendor merged into SpaceX on 2026-05-07 and its own pages now name it SpaceXAI, so display_name follows the vendor while provider_id does not: that identifier is the key the sealed credential store, the three compiled sign-in tables and the mark table are all written against, and moving it would strand every credential a person has already saved.
